title: Remove folinic-acid exact alias from the folic-acid owner
body:
The existing folic-acid owner retains `Folinic acid (citrovorum)` as an exact synonym. The selected W04 B9 addition preserves this inherited defect. ChEBI:27470 and ChEBI:15640 distinguish folic acid (C19H19N7O6) from folinic acid (C20H23N7O7); an overlapping entry term is not an identity proof.

Exact reviewed scope:
- Finding `CH-01`; stable key `w04-independent-CH-01`; immutable peer review `20261108T070033Z-w04-successor-science-v1`.
- `w04-chem-proposal-folate-b9`; owner `data/ingredients/mapped/Folic_Acid.yaml`; before `df85938271ec8f32a6d756f5213ba9661c9a7530822f333d2e02493b9f92e615`; proposed SHA256 `79b9b94956ba546897ca69172654b62bc1ff4ecd894a828da51dbe91cf4d2e2a`.
  [Exact published proposal](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/548e7bdd0ce2a68b3ae0df6ad7a6150a4e5c9bb9/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-04/proposals/chemistry/Folic_Acid.after.yaml).

Retain the supported B9 alias. Preserve the incorrect folinic spelling and its original source as a rejected identity candidate with a new, honest curation event. Do not map generic folinic material, calcium salts or stereoisomers to another owner without their own evidence. The current folic primary identity is not being replaced.

Evidence:

- [Primary/ontology source](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/ontologies/chebi/terms?obo_id=CHEBI:27470); capture SHA256 `d762aa241a3e18e4ffd7abf2f1537b85da9738265ba0407c2afd3029451bff23`; Complete term definition, label, synonyms, formula/charge/structure annotations and CAS cross-reference where present; not source procurement proof.
- [Primary/ontology source](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/ontologies/chebi/terms?obo_id=CHEBI:15640); capture SHA256 `4b69b509678ff4dd9961814dfc098d2585a53ac34728db220def4f2f494086eb`; CompleteCHEBI15640 term; folinic/5-formyltetrahydrofolic acid name andC20H23N7O7 formula versus27470.

Deduplication: All-state folinic/Folic_Acid searches returned no exact tracker. #1201 concerns source completion, not this inherited cross-substance alias.

Review context: W04 published head `548e7bdd0ce2a68b3ae0df6ad7a6150a4e5c9bb9`, frozen campaign base `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`. Main as observed at `0dac278466699129a083343a921c2e0ca18a9ab4` has the same eighteen affected inherited-owner blobs as the frozen baseline; this is not a report of already-applied campaign curation. The full independent assembly covers 188 source cases and 115 proposals and remains `needs_curation`. Original peer review and evidence are immutable. Agent-authored new mapping evidence must satisfy #1226 without relabeling historical human evidence. The fix must use existing native guarded proposal validation and independent re-review; it grants no maintained-owner or export approval and requires no new gate, threshold, or synonym-selection rule.
